provenance.author: Cut, layered and mixed by this project's agents from recordings by: MintoDog; RandomMind; vitalezzz
provenance.license: Every source is CC0 1.0 Universal (per-source statements in recipe.json and docs/assets.md); the edits are released the same way
provenance.origin: Fantasy: Lament for a Warrior's Soul <https://opengameart.org/content/fantasy-lament-for-a-warriors-soul>; Medieval: Battle <https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-battle>; Great Labyrinth (Orchestral dungeon music) <https://opengameart.org/content/great-labyrinthorchestral-dungeon-music>; The Ancient Legend <https://opengameart.org/content/the-ancient-legend>; Medieval: Victory Theme <https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-victory-theme>; Medieval: Defeat Theme <https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-defeat-theme>

recipe.method: tools/audio_beds.py build --recipe Art/audio-music/r001/recipe.json --downloads .local/music-downloads: per piece, an ffmpeg cut of the source in recipe.json to 48 kHz stereo float; a track is rendered crossfade seconds past its loop length and folded over its head with an equal-power crossfade at a loop point chosen where the audio after the start and after the end match (log-spectrum cosine similarity); a sting is cut at a phrase break and released; then one gain to the category loudness (music -27 LUFS, stings -23 LUFS) capped at -1 dBTP, then triangular dither to 16-bit PCM
recipe.approved_reference: Ticket #245 and spec #239: a war-table/menu theme, combat loops alternating by stage, a Vault finale track, victory and defeat stings; dark high fantasy, sparse
recipe.raw_downloads: not committed: each source file used is listed with its SHA-256 in recipe.json, and build refuses a mismatch

tools.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version n9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

settings.data_asset: /Game/DnDDiceRoll/Audio/DA_ExpeditionMusic (UExpeditionMusicSounds: track and sting -> wave and volume from recipe.json, music class)
settings.looping: tracks loop (play when silent); stings play once
settings.rerun: kept when DiceRollSourceSha256 matches; replaced only with DND_MUSIC_REIMPORT=1
